required_outcomes: Responds to the injury with care and checks she is safe and managing.
Seeks a sooner visit from Swift on R-4801 (or a linked urgent job) because water is now reaching the floor.
Records the injury and escalates it to a human (possible liability or insurance), and tells the landlord.
Gives practical interim advice: isolate the tap at the valve under the sink and keep the floor dry.
acceptable_alternatives: Opening a linked urgent job for the leak while keeping R-4801.
positive_behaviours: Asks for photos of the leak and the floor.
red_flags: Replying only with the Thursday slot.
